**STEP 6 - Grams:** Whole fruit has a bulk density of about 0.7 g/ml, which gives 220 × 0.7 ≈ 155 g. A medium apple of this size typically weighs about 160 g, so I use 160 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Raw apple is about 52 kcal per 100 g, so 160 g × 0.52 ≈ 83 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A single medium apple at about 160 g and about 80 kcal is plausible for what is shown.
